name: Onii-Chan
source:
The thing is that he has two sisters who love him far not like just sisters, and the modest student constantly becomes the witness of their erotic tricks.
And if only they showed their feelings to him just in home, but they keep on doing it if they have a chance, which is causing some troubles, too.
It's also should be mentioned that the whole situation makes Sora an object of the brutal jealousy from his classmates and his strong reputation as a pervert was stuck in the classmates' minds.
So, where sisters' attempts to seduce their own brother will take them?

[From [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/807920/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
问题是，他有两个姐妹，她们不仅像姐妹一样爱他，而且这个谦虚的学生不断成为她们色情伎俩的见证人。
如果他们只是在家里向他表达自己的感情就好了，但如果有机会他们就会继续这样做，这也造成了一些麻烦。
还值得一提的是，整个情况让空成为了同学们残酷嫉妒的对象，他变态的名声也深深印在了同学们的心目中。
那么，姐妹们勾引自己的兄弟的企图会把她们带向何方呢？

[来自[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/807920/]Steam[/url]]
